verdict.rationale: Teams doesn't offer a built-in no-code 'rules that trigger actions on events' engine for end users, but it does expose event-driven automation building blocks — outgoing webhooks/connectors that fire on channel events, and Graph API calls to automate creating teams/channels/messages — which developers can wire into automation flows. This falls short of a native, user-defined trigger/action rule system; missing for 10: a first-party in-product rules/automation builder (e.g. Power Automate-style triggers) accessible to non-developer 'AI-native' users, and independent evidence that such rules actually fire reliably in practice.
